## lesson

### Storage order is producer-dependent

LibreOffice, mPDF, iTextSharp and Chrome store visual order; ReportLab, wkhtmltopdf and PDFreactor store logical order. A blanket reverse fixes one family and corrupts the other: recover from /ActualText, then ToUnicode + UAX 9 levels, then an allow-listed producer fingerprint, otherwise refuse.

*source:* field evidence, corpus/manifest.json producer_class

*recorded:* 2026-09-27T12:50:45Z

### Inherit the failure corpus, not just the code

The sibling fork documented 15+ named RTL failure modes plus 27 pinned tests. That catalogue is the acceptance suite for our pipeline: each documented bug becomes a fixture, including the ones that must return unsupported_*.

*source:* yolka-wiz/al-bdf-engine docs/PROBLEMS.md

*recorded:* 2026-09-27T12:50:45Z

### WSL needs IPv4 preference on this host

WSL has no IPv6 route while DNS returns AAAA records: curl and cargo silently fail with HTTP 000. Fix is a precedence line in /etc/gai.conf (precedence ::ffff:0:0/96 100). Do not remove it.

*recorded:* 2026-09-27T12:50:45Z

## pitfall

### CIDToGIDMap must be a 65536-entry stream for 2-byte CIDs

ISO 32000-1 9.7.4.3. A short array makes strict renderers fall back to Identity and paint Latin glyphs: a sibling project shipped Arabic that rendered as A while its golden tests stayed green, because the tests never pixel-verified their own output. Mandatory mitigation: pixel oracle in CI.

*source:* ISO 32000-1 9.7.4.3

*recorded:* 2026-09-27T12:50:45Z

### HarfBuzz 4+ already emits RTL runs leftmost-first

Re-applying the classic fpdf2 issue 1802 reversal to output from HarfBuzz 4+ MIRRORS the text. Reversal must be driven by bidi level parity, never applied twice.

*source:* https://github.com/fpdf2/fpdf/issues/1802

*recorded:* 2026-09-27T12:50:45Z

### ToUnicode carries one UTF-16 unit per glyph

Ligatures degrade: lam-alef collapses to a single letter. The exact logical text survives only in /ActualText marked content, so extraction and generation are one problem, not two.

*source:* PDF 32000-1 9.10.2 / 14.9.4

*recorded:* 2026-09-27T12:50:45Z

### ZWNJ/ZWJ stripping is for matching only

U+200C in Persian is semantic (mi-ra-va-m). Strip it when comparing search terms, never in stored or emitted text; the exact form lives in /ActualText.

*recorded:* 2026-09-27T12:50:45Z

## spec

### cargo uses the Aliyun sparse mirror here

Direct crates.io CDN is unreliable from this network; ~/.cargo/config.toml replaces it with sparse+https://mirrors.aliyun.com/crates.io-index/ (verified HTTP 200). Rust 1.97.1 was already installed in WSL; there is no Rust on the Windows host.

*recorded:* 2026-09-27T12:50:45Z
